CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` PROCEDURE `p_tx`(IN p_id BIGINT UNSIGNED, OUT p_msg VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin) SQL SECURITY DEFINER COMMENT 'cierre; diario' BEGIN START TRANSACTION; UPDATE `t` SET `n` = `n` + 1 WHERE id = p_id; COMMIT; END

CREATE PROCEDURE p_types(IN a DECIMAL(10,2) UNSIGNED, IN b ENUM('uno','dos'), IN c SET('x','y'), IN d VARBINARY(32), IN e DOUBLE PRECISION, IN f CHAR(4) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) LANGUAGE SQL DETERMINISTIC CONTAINS SQL BEGIN SELECT a, b, c, d, e, f; END

CREATE PROCEDURE p_cursor() BEGIN DECLARE done BOOL DEFAULT FALSE; DECLARE x, y INT DEFAULT 0; DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT id, n FROM t WHERE n > 0; DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE; OPEN c; read_loop: LOOP FETCH c INTO x, y; IF done THEN LEAVE read_loop; END IF; UPDATE t SET n = y WHERE id = x; END LOOP read_loop; CLOSE c; END

CREATE PROCEDURE p_handlers() BEGIN DECLARE bad CONDITION FOR SQLSTATE '45000'; DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION BEGIN ROLLBACK; RESIGNAL; END; START TRANSACTION; INSERT INTO t(id) VALUES (1); COMMIT; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_if(IN x INT) BEGIN IF x > 0 THEN INSERT INTO t(id) VALUES (x); ELSEIF x = 0 THEN UPDATE t SET n = 0 WHERE id = x; ELSE DELETE FROM t WHERE id = x; END IF; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_while() BEGIN DECLARE x INT DEFAULT 0; outer_loop: WHILE x < 5 DO SET x = x + 1; IF x = 3 THEN ITERATE outer_loop; END IF; INSERT INTO t(id) VALUES (x); END WHILE outer_loop; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_repeat() BEGIN DECLARE x INT DEFAULT 0; REPEAT SET x = x + 1; UNTIL x > 2 END REPEAT; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_case(IN x INT) BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN SET x = 2; WHEN 2 THEN SET x = 3; ELSE SET x = 4; END CASE; SELECT CASE WHEN x > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS state; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_signal() BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'bad; value'; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_dynamic() BEGIN SET @sql = 'SELECT 1;'; PREPARE stmt FROM @sql; EXECUTE stmt; DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt; END
CREATE FUNCTION f_add(IN a INT, IN b INT) RETURNS INT DETERMINISTIC NO SQL BEGIN DECLARE x INT DEFAULT 0; SET x = a + b; RETURN x; END
CREATE FUNCTION f_one() RETURNS INT DETERMINISTIC RETURN 1
CREATE TRIGGER t_bi BEFORE INSERT ON t FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.n = COALESCE(NEW.n, 0); INSERT INTO log(id) VALUES (NEW.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_au AFTER UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO log(id) VALUES (OLD.id)
CREATE TRIGGER t_bd BEFORE DELETE ON t FOR EACH ROW SET @deleted = OLD.id
CREATE EVENT e_daily ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 DAY DO BEGIN DELETE FROM log WHERE id < 10; END
CREATE EVENT e_once ON SCHEDULE AT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 HOUR DO INSERT INTO log(id) VALUES (1)
CREATE PROCEDURE p_into() BEGIN SELECT id, n INTO @id, @n FROM t WHERE id = 1; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_query() BEGIN SELECT id FROM t WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE n > 0) UNION SELECT id FROM v; WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM t) SELECT id FROM c; END
CREATE PROCEDURE p_json() BEGIN SELECT j.x FROM JSON_TABLE('[{"x":1}]', '$[*]' COLUMNS(x INT PATH '$.x')) AS j; INSERT INTO t(id,n) VALUES (1,2) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE n = VALUES(n); END

CREATE PROCEDURE `p_comment`() BEGIN /* café; begin; end */ SELECT 'a; b' AS `texto`; -- nota; fin
 INSERT INTO `t` (`id`) VALUES (1); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_ai AFTER INSERT ON t FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO log(id) VALUES (NEW.id)
CREATE TRIGGER t_bu BEFORE UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.n = COALESCE(NEW.n, OLD.n); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_ad AFTER DELETE ON t FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO log(id) VALUES (OLD.id)
CREATE PROCEDURE p_labels() BEGIN block_a: BEGIN DECLARE n INT DEFAULT 1; loop_a: LOOP IF n > 3 THEN LEAVE loop_a; END IF; SET n = n + 1; END LOOP loop_a; END block_a; END
